# Reading speed test

Canonical page: https://nepocore.com/tools/reading-speed/

Time yourself reading a pasted passage and calculate an approximate words-per-minute rate. Start when ready and finish when you reach the end.

## How to use it

1. Choose a study tool and review its input labels.
2. Enter your scores, course details, passage or available study time.
3. Run the tool and review the result and its assumptions.

## Example

Read a 300-word practice passage, then compare your reading rate across several sessions.

## Limits and checks

This measures time, not comprehension. Keep the tool open and use comparable passages for a meaningful comparison.

## Access and processing

Free to use without an account. Interactive processing requires JavaScript in a modern browser. Input is processed in the browser rather than sent to a processing server. Optional browser storage is not a synchronized account.
